title: Hook contract freeze and API v2
notes: Outbound hooks cover CSV import, calendar due-date sync, custom field writes, project create/delete, comment edit/delete/restore, sprint update/delete, member role changes, invites, and import.completed

Breaking: comment edit/delete/restore no longer fire outbound task.commented; they use task.comment_edited, task.comment_deleted, and task.comment_restored. The live UI still refreshes on task.commented
Breaking: inbound webhooks require project_id. HMAC signatures must include X-Ordryn-Timestamp and sign timestamp + "." + body
Breaking: deleting a project fires project.deleted instead of project.updated
Breaking: the public REST API is now /api/v2 (OpenAPI 2.0.0). /api/v1 remains as a compatibility alias for existing webhooks, OAuth callbacks, and clients
Breaking: task favoriting is removed. The favorite field is no longer accepted or returned; reorder no longer groups by favorite; CSV import ignores a favorite column
task.updated is no longer double-fired with status/due/project/sprint/tag hooks; it remains for leftover field edits. Subscribe to task.status_changed for column moves
Catch-all trigger *, status include/exclude filters, nested JSON objects (actor_detail, task_detail, project_detail, changes), digest event lists, dead-letter status, and delivery retry APIs
Site Admin → Extensions can set site triggers/templates, send a test, and retry failed deliveries
Host API 2: extensions can declare kanban.tab surfaces and a project document store; the board Retro tab is a sandboxed iframe that talks through a parent postMessage bridge
settings.scope accepts a string or array (site, project, kanban, user). member remains an alias of user
Breaking: settings.scope project is classic/list projects only and no longer includes kanban boards. Use ["project", "kanban"] for a team destination on both
Project members can review enabled extensions (name, description, triggers, and webhook hostname) without seeing secrets, quiet hours, or other owner settings

title: Configurable image hosting
notes: Admins can enable image hosting with an S3-compatible backend (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, DigitalOcean Spaces, MinIO) or local disk uploads
Admin settings include the API endpoint, region, bucket, credentials, public URL, path-style option, local directory, and a maximum image size
Signed-in users can upload JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP images into task descriptions and comments when hosting is configured
Failed uploads show a generic message to users; site admins can Test connection to verify the backend without exposing provider XML or secrets
S3 uploads talk HTTP/1.1 (Cloudflare R2 returns 502 over HTTP/2)
Saving image hosting settings keeps the API endpoint, region, and path-style checkbox as entered
Inserted images render inline in task descriptions and discussion comments, like GitHub — paste or drop a file, or use Insert image; clicking opens the picture in a new tab

title: Editable discussion comments
notes: Authors can edit their own task discussion comments; project owners can edit anyone's comment on that project
Comments show posted and edited timestamps; hover the edited date to see who originally posted it
Previous comment text is kept in an audit log so project owners and site admins can review and restore it
Site admins can browse and restore comment history from Admin → Comment history

title: Task favoriting deprecated
notes: Starred tasks are removed from the web UI; starring is no longer available in the Vue app
The API still accepts favorite on create, update, reorder, and import, and returns a deprecation notice when it is used
Task favoriting is removed in API v2

title: Archive projects
notes: Project owners can archive a project so it moves into an Archived section instead of cluttering active lists
Archiving a project automatically applies the protected archived tag to its tasks
Archived projects cannot accept new tasks (including subtasks and moves); restore them to add work again
Only the project owner can archive or restore a project

title: Mention teammates in task discussions
notes: Type @ in a task comment to autocomplete project members, using the same prefix search as project invites
Autocomplete only lists members of that project who match what you typed
Mentioned members get a You were mentioned notification; other members still get the usual new-comment notice

title: Kanban sprints
notes: Kanban projects can define named sprints with start and end dates on the Sprints tab in project settings
Sprints can include a short description that shows with the name (e.g. 3.0.0 - features required for v3.0.0 release)
Each sprint can set a lock date; after that date only the project owner can add tasks
Sprint date ranges cannot overlap; a sprint may start the day after another ends
Assign a task to a sprint (or leave it in the backlog) from the task sidebar
Saving a task actually updates its sprint assignment, including moving it to the backlog
The board has a sprint switcher so you can move between the active sprint, other sprints, and the backlog
Each board card belongs to the selected sprint: a subtask on Sprint 1 no longer appears on Backlog

title: Optional two-factor authentication
notes: You can turn on authenticator-app (TOTP) MFA in Settings; it is off by default
After you confirm a code you get five one-time recovery codes
Login asks for a TOTP or recovery code when MFA is enabled; turning MFA off requires the same proof
Password reset does not disable MFA; API keys continue to skip the MFA login step

title: Live task updates
notes: Task lists, kanban boards, calendar, and dashboard refresh immediately when another tab or collaborator changes a task
Uses Server-Sent Events plus Redis so multiple app instances stay in sync
An in-progress edit in the task sidebar is not overwritten; you get a notice instead

title: Per-project tags
notes: Tags are scoped per project and shared with members; inbox tasks keep personal tags
Only project owners and editors can add, rename, or delete project tags
Task list filters show that project's tags, or unique tag names when viewing all tasks
Moving a task between projects keeps tags whose names exist in the destination and drops the rest

title: Stable SPA release — Vue UI, JSON API, HTMX removed
notes: First stable release: Vue 3 SPA at /app/ over JSON /api/v1; HTMX stack removed
Full and API-only deploy modes; OpenAPI contract and SPA API docs
Task board parity restored: sidebar edit, drag reorder, infinite scroll, filters, saved views
Device authorization for Android SSO; footer restored with Ordryn credit

title: Calendar, digest, security hardening
notes: In-app calendar view and ICS due-date import on Profile
Daily email digest (opt-in), completed-this-week filter, extended undo with ID restore
Calendar feed security: empty response for bad tokens, ban enforcement, RFC ICS improvements
Profile CSRF, validation, RequireAuth; shared DB pool; subpath routing; hx-boost nav; filter URL sync

title: Profile calendar feed fixes
notes: Fixed ICS subscribe URL duplicating the site URL when basePath is configured as a full URL
Fixed Copy button on Profile not copying the calendar feed URL (clipboard fallback for HTTP)

title: UX consistency and guidance
notes: Undo toast now matches 60-second server window
Bulk delete and undo re-bind HTMX so edit/toggle work without refresh
Edit form Activity panel fixed for CSP (no evalDisallowedError)
Global HTMX error toasts for failed requests and network errors
Filter chips on all screen sizes with click-to-remove and Clear all filters
Bulk delete uses same styled modal as single delete; project/tag delete requires confirmation
Empty states with Add Task, Clear search, and Reset filters actions
Dashboard stat cards link to filtered home views
Keyboard: Enter edits focused row; d opens delete
Bulk due-date presets (Today, Tomorrow, +1 week)
Import success shows View tasks link; tag filter refreshes after tag changes
Profile logic moved to profile.js module; loading indicators on projects and pagination

title: Post-roadmap features and UX polish
notes: Undo delete, ICS calendar feed, import preview, bulk due-date actions
Loading indicators, sidebar backdrop, sticky bulk bar, mobile filter collapse
Calendar sync discoverability and undo-aware delete messaging

title: Initial changelog
notes: Added changelog modal UI
Changelog entries are stored in config/changelog.json and served at /changelog
Optionally, changelog can be fetched from GitHub releases if GITHUB_REPO is set in .env
